a: About 35 one-year Regular awards averaging $75K; 1-2 Large awards of up to 3 years averaging $125K a year
dt: Phase-1 proposals due Jan 28, 2027, 4:30 pm ET via ARK/RPS (ROSES-25 Amendment 80); only selected proposers submit Phase-2 budgets
e: NASA's yearly Fermi guest investigator program, mostly funding for analysis of Fermi LAT and GBM data, correlative multiwavelength analysis and theory that advances Fermi science; a small part covers LAT pointed observations. Only PIs at US institutions can be funded.
unv: The Fermi Science Support Center site could not be reached; the date is confirmed on the NASA ROSES pages. The call does not say whether students or postdocs may be PI.
